line.name: Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary Maduro
line.description: Box-pressed, bourbon-barrel-aged Nicaraguan Maduro wrapper edition of the Reserve 10th Anniversary line - a parallel wrapper edition to the site's existing 'Reserve 10th Anniversary Champagne' (Connecticut) and 'Reserve 10th Anniversary Box-Pressed Maduro' entries. Not currently listed as its own line on the site under this exact name - if the site's existing 'Box-Pressed Maduro' entry is meant to represent this same product, review before merging (this entry uses a plain 'Epicure' vitola size matching Champagne, while the site's Box-Pressed Maduro entry uses a different vitola set - Churchill/Epicure/Figurado/Robusto/Super Toro/Torpedo - so they may already be the same line under a different vitola list, or may be two distinct product generations. Recommend manual review.)

research_notes: Only Epicure has direct Mac photo evidence. Robusto is included because it's independently verified via Cigar Coop's review title/content, but Churchill, Figurado, Super Toro, and Torpedo could not be confirmed to exist in this specific wrapper edition and are NOT included - flag as UNVERIFIED rather than assumed present.
